svg.title: Max-heap construction from array
svg.desc: Shows array 10,20,15,40,50,100,25 built into a max-heap with 100 as root
svg.text: Max-Heap property: every parent ≥ its children (root = maximum)
Min-Heap property: every parent ≤ its children (root = minimum)
Build heap: O(n) | Insert: O(log n) | Extract max/min: O(log n) | Heap Sort: O(n log n)
